row.evidence: PDQ Deploy & Inventory is licensed per admin ($1,950 per admin/year) and its console users are Windows accounts added via Options > Console Users; the help centre documents no SCIM or provisioning API.
row.notes: New row. PDQ Deploy & Inventory is the on-prem Windows product (now sold alongside the cloud PDQ Connect, per-device pricing). Users are admins who each need a licence; console access is granted to Windows/AD accounts in Console Users, with RBAC since 20.0.5.0. The PDQ.com billing portal (licences, team) supports Google/Microsoft sign-in and custom OIDC (Okta, Entra ID, OneLogin, Duo, Oracle IDCS), with team members invited and removed manually; OIDC users must already be registered with the same email. No SCIM anywhere in the help centre. PDQ Connect has a device-focused REST API without user endpoints.

plans.name: Deploy & Inventory
plans.notes: Per-admin licence, unlimited endpoints. Single on-prem tier; console access is by Windows account (Console Users) with RBAC from version 20.0.5.0.

limitations.text: PDQ Deploy & Inventory is a Windows on-premises console with no documented REST API. The separate PDQ Connect REST API covers devices, groups, deployments, packages, custom fields and vulnerabilities, not users.

fallbacks.other_sync: Console access granted to Windows/Active Directory accounts (Console Users); PDQ.com portal team members invited manually, with optional custom OIDC sign-in
